name: Amazon BFI4 Fulfillment Center Kent WA

fieldNotes.truckGate: Controlled, guarded truck gate at NE corner off the north service road: channelized lanes with crosshatch markings, barrier arms/bollards (yellow+orange) across the lanes, chain-link perimeter fencing both sides. Confirmed in satellite (z20) and 2025-05 Street View at the gate.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small white guard booth structure beside the gate lanes, ~1-2 vehicle footprint, visible in z20 satellite and Street View.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False - staffed guard booth present, so not a remote/kiosk-only check-in.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved yard equipment / staging area inside the gate before the dock apron (visible parked yard tractors and open paved holding area).
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep paved gate-to-dock approach and a wide internal truck drive can stack well more than 3 trucks.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: ~2 inbound lanes estimated from overhead channelization; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide gate apron with multiple channelized lanes and unused paved width - room to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Continuous bank of dock doors runs the full north building face with trailers backed in along its entire length; well into the 50+ band (estimated ~90 doors).
fieldNotes.dropArea: Long row of parked trailers without tractors staged along the north fence line in addition to docked trailers; 50+ band.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated north trailer drop/storage row distinct from the active dock apron.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Kent industrial valley within the Seattle metro - dense surrounding industrial/distribution fabric = Urban.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property in any imagery.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~47.5 acres derived from the traced perimeter polygon.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Single continuous dock bank on the north face; shipping/receiving not on physically separate building faces.
fieldNotes.streetViewMeta: Google Street View coverage exists along the north service road (panos captured 2025-05); pano ids not hard-coded - heading values point the camera from the road toward each zone.
